correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable contract from the diff: PR-number validation, allow-list normalization with [bot] stripping and comment skipping, env defaults (INTERVAL=20, QUIET_WINDOW=360, MAX_WAIT=900), head SHA checks before and after each GraphQL snapshot plus snap_head cross-check, machine-readable RESULT=/HEAD= emission on every exit path, and poll-loop branches for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR. Terminal-bot detection keys on latest review commit.oid matching the tracked head and unresolved allow-listed bot-authored threads block convergence. Minor contract gaps: reviews and reviewThreads are capped at first:100 without pagination, terminal detection does not filter review state (e.g. CHANGES_REQUESTED vs APPROVED), and bots with zero prior reviews are not treated as non-terminal participants.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent (set -uo pipefail, script-relative ALLOWLIST_FILE resolution, dedicated scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll-smoke.sh, required-files and scripts lint inventory updates). The 376-line shell file is well sectioned with header contract documentation, progress diagnostics, and inline GraphQL/jq consistent with other gh-based scripts. Docs are comprehensively synced: pr-resolve-all.md adds helper preference, exit/result dispatch table, env var table, and preserved time-based QUIET_WINDOW fallback; AI_REPO_GUIDE.md documents both new artifacts. Small deduction for not extracting jq filters to scripts/lib/jq and using printf-only diagnostics instead of shared logging.sh.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to eight on-task files (helper, allow-list, bats tests, three check scripts, and required doc/prompt surfaces) with no AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or live-state churn. pr-resolve-all.md prefers the deterministic helper while preserving the documented QUIET_WINDOW fallback and defers the #321 round-marker contract. Companion maintenance covers required-files inventory, scripts lint inventory, and a dedicated smoke check wired through test.sh.

reliability.rationale: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats covers bash -n, allow-list shape invariants, and CLI/precondition API_ERROR paths (missing PR, non-numeric PR, missing/empty/comment-only allow-list) plus RESULT=/HEAD= format. The bats header explicitly states no live gh API calls and the file provides no mock-gh coverage for poll-loop decision paths (CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED) or convergence/quiet-window logic embedded in the main loop. Objective grading skipped bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh; wiring is credible (test_wiring 2/2) but poll-loop contract paths are evidenced only by code inspection, weaker than peers with fixture or mock-gh scenario tests.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper was skipped in objective-grade.json; reliability score treats precondition bats as structurally sound but does not assume poll-loop scenarios passed at runtime.

Live GitHub polling behavior (timing-based QUIET_ELAPSED/TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED during fetch, convergence with real bot reviews) is only evidenced by diff inspection, not executed integration or mock tests in the bundle.

citations.claim: hard_gate_pass is true, enabling normal subjective scoring rather than fail-closed zeroing.
scripts/pr-resolve-all-poll.sh documents and implements exit 0 (CONVERGED/QUIET_ELAPSED), 2 (TIMEOUT), 3 (SHA_CHANGED), 4 (API_ERROR) with final stdout line RESULT=<value> HEAD=<sha>.

Poll loop sleeps INTERVAL, checks MAX_WAIT, fetches head SHA before snapshot, fetches full GraphQL state, fetches head SHA after snapshot, and compares snap_head from snapshot for SHA_CHANGED detection.
CONVERGED emits when _all_terminal==1 and _unresolved_threads==0; QUIET_ELAPSED emits when elapsed time since _LAST_EVENT_TIME meets QUIET_WINDOW.
GraphQL _STATE_QUERY fetches reviews(first:100) and reviewThreads(first:100) with comments(first:1) only — no pagination beyond first page.

Precondition failures (missing args, non-numeric PR, missing/empty allow-list, missing gh/jq/date, gh auth failure, repo resolution failure, initial head fetch failure) emit RESULT=API_ERROR HEAD=unknown with exit 4.
scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt lists seven normalized bot identities (gemini-code-assist through claude) with header documentation.
pr-resolve-all.md adds Between-round settle window section preferring scripts/pr-resolve-all-poll.sh with result dispatch table and retains documented sleep QUIET_WINDOW fallback on API_ERROR.
scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats states tests exercise failure exits before network and do not make live gh API calls.
bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed; bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh skipped; test_wiring matched 2/2 patterns.
Eight focused files spanning helper, allow-list, bats tests, checks, and doc/prompt surfaces with no unrelated scope.
